title: Wire struct UAPI copy drifts silently from kernel driver
description: Scenario: developer adds or reorders a field in the kernel driver's UAPI structs (e.g., crypto2dev_init_op) without updating crypto2dev_wire.h. The _IOW macro encodes sizeof(struct) into the ioctl request code; a size mismatch causes the ioctl to fail with ENOTTY or EINVAL — no message, just a hard error. The CRYPTO2DEV_HAVE_UAPI_HEADER escape hatch exists in crypto2dev_wire.h but is not wired into configure.ac, so users who have the kernel headers at build time don't get the protection. Maintenance consequence: every kernel driver ABI change requires a manual update to crypto2dev_wire.h that can easily be missed. The wire the configure.ac --with-crypto2dev-uapi-header path or add a CI check that compares struct sizes.
